title: Number properties and patterns
summary: Factors, multiples, HCF and LCM, divisibility, primes, indices, squares and square roots, number patterns, rules and the Cartesian plane.

cards.title: Factors and multiples
cards.rule: Factors go into a number. Multiples come out of its times table.

cards.title: HCF and LCM
cards.rule: Highest common factor: the biggest number into both. Lowest common multiple: the smallest both go into.

cards.title: Divisibility tests
cards.rule: By 2: even. By 3: digits add to a multiple of 3. By 5: ends in 0 or 5. By 9: digits add to a multiple of 9.
lines: 126: digits add to 9, so it divides by 3 and 9

cards.title: Prime numbers
cards.rule: A prime has exactly two factors: 1 and itself.
lines: 1 isn't prime. 2 is the only even prime.

cards.title: Using indices
cards.rule: The index counts how many times the base multiplies: \(5 \times 5 \times 5 = 5^3\).

cards.title: Prime decomposition
cards.rule: Use a factor tree until every branch ends in a prime.

cards.title: Number patterns
cards.rule: Find what happens each step: add a number, or multiply by one.

cards.title: Spatial patterns
cards.rule: Count how much each new shape adds, then write a rule.

cards.title: Tables and rules
cards.rule: The step in the output tells you what to multiply by.

cards.title: The Cartesian plane
cards.rule: \((x, y)\): across first, then up. The origin is \((0, 0)\).
